fullPassage:
Eiffel Tower Effect

Have you ever heard of the "Eiffel Tower Effect?" When the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron tower was very different from all the other architecture in Paris, which was mainly made of stone. Many local people disliked the tower and complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris. Nevertheless, as the locals became familiar with the tower due to exposure, they became more and more fond of it, referring to it as the Tower of Love. This effect, also called the "Mere Exposure Effect," is found with people, too. Psychologist Robert Zajonc and his colleagues showed university students pictures of several faces. Some pictures were shown 25 times while others were shown only once or twice. Then, the students were shown a picture and asked to express how much they liked that person. The students liked the people they had seen more often better than those they had seen less frequently. This shows that the more we are exposed to something, the more favorably we view it.

det.korean: ④ referred → referring. 분사구문으로 주어(they)가 능동적으로 '부르는' 행위를 함. 현재분사 referring이 올바름.

✅ 정답 ④ referred: 분사구문(능동) → referring(현재분사). they가 부르는 주체이므로 능동
❌ ① which: 계속적 용법 관계대명사. 올바름
❌ ② ruin: would + 동사원형. 올바름
❌ ③ more and more: 비교급 강조. 올바름
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어가 행위의 주체(능동) → -ing. 주어가 행위의 대상(수동) → p.p. they가 부르는 주체 → referring.

questions.passage: When the Eiffel Tower was first built, the iron tower was very different from all the other architecture in Paris, which was mainly made of stone. Many local people disliked the tower and complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.

"에펠탑은 파리의 모든 다른 건축물과 매우 달랐다."

→ The iron tower was very __________ from all the other architecture in Paris.

(한 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'was very different from all the other architecture' — 달랐다.
det.analysis: ✅ different: different from = ~와 다른. 원문에서 직접 찾기.
det.tip: different from: ~와 다른. be different from = ~와 다르다. ※ different than(미국식)도 가능하나 원문은 from.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

"지역 주민들이 탑에 친숙해지면서, 그들은 점점 더 그것을 좋아하게 되었다."

→ As the locals became familiar with the tower, they became __________ of it.

(more, and, more, fond를 사용하여 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'became more and more fond of it' — 점점 더 좋아하게 되었다.
det.analysis: ✅ more and more fond: more and more + 형용사 = 점점 더 ~한. fond of = ~을 좋아하는.
det.tip: more and more + 형용사: 점점 더 ~한. became fond of = ~을 좋아하게 되다.

questions.passage: Many local people disliked the tower and complained that it would ruin the beauty of Paris. Nevertheless, as the locals became familiar with the tower due to exposure, they became more and more fond of it, referring to it as the Tower of Love.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장을 주어진 조건에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.

"주민들은 에펠탑을 사랑의 탑이라고 불렀다."

→ The locals referred to the tower as the Tower of __________.

(한 단어를 쓰시오)

det.korean: 원문: 'referring to it as the Tower of Love' — 사랑의 탑.
det.analysis: ✅ Love: 원문에서 직접 찾기. Tower of Love = 사랑의 탑.
det.tip: refer to A as B: A를 B라고 부르다. Tower of Love = 사랑의 탑. 태도 변화의 결과.
